The common-equity bridge is provisional: reported book debt and a dated diluted-share proxy are used; unidentified non-operating assets and claims are not verified.

Industry non-cash working-capital scenario: 24.42% of revenue · Machinery · 105 US firms · 2026-01. Model opening NWC = base revenue × this ratio; forecast investment = change in revenue × this ratio. Company balances are incomplete or use different dates; none is replaced with a reported zero. Industry non-cash working-capital scenario: 10.04% of revenue · Environmental & Waste Services · 53 US firms · 2026-01. Model opening NWC = base revenue × this ratio; forecast investment = change in revenue × this ratio. Company balances are incomplete or use different dates; none is replaced with a reported zero.
